title: SEC Approves Tesla Retail Shareholder Auto-Vote Ahead of SpaceX Merger
detail: The SEC approved Tesla's request to allow automatic board-direction voting for retail shareholders ahead of a proposed Tesla–SpaceX merger, marking a significant corporate governance milestone that could reshape how ordinary investors participate in major EV-sector mergers.

title: EVgo Announces 750 kW Ultra-Fast Charging System Coming in 2027
detail: EVgo announced a 750 kW ultra-fast charging system slated for deployment in 2027, pushing public EV charging infrastructure toward speeds that rival the fastest proprietary networks and marking a major leap beyond current 350 kW fast-charger installations.
